Used oil EPR guide

The 2026-27 used oil EPR target is 20%.

CPCB's FAQ states that the obligation is based on base oil or lubricating oil sold or imported two years earlier. Producers should confirm registration, sales data and certificate planning early.

Discuss EPR support ↗ Call sales

For 2026-27, the recycling target is 20% of the base oil or lubricating oil sold or imported in 2024-25.

Who should review the obligation?

Entities selling or importing base oil or lubricating oil in India should verify whether they fall within the producer definition and confirm their portal registration position.

How the target is calculated

The annual obligation is linked to the quantity placed on the market two years earlier. The reporting data and entity scope should be reconciled before certificates are planned.

Actions for this quarter

  1. Confirm the sales volume used for the obligation.
  2. Check registration and filing status on the used oil EPR portal.
  3. Review registered recyclers and certificate history.
  4. Compare the available compliance routes.
  5. Keep transaction and certificate records aligned.

Source: CPCB Frequently Asked Questions on EPR for Used Oil Management. Obtain professional compliance advice for your entity.
